reason: A is more physically plausible and testable because it links measured dislocation/lattice-strain evolution to temperature-dependent strength, hardening, and creep, with in situ observations and a clear falsification criterion. B incorrectly treats the elements of a nominally single-phase alloy as separate composite constituents, conflates thermal-expansion mismatch with microsegregation, and predicts lower creep after removing putative pinning stresses without a sound mechanism.
